units.title: Canonical full-text capture prerequisite for source review
repercussions: Without this binding, a reviewer could type an unregistered hash and approve a source whose exact document version is absent, stale, abstract-only, or mismatched.
units.scope: New source-review receipts bind a current, byte-verified LiteratureStore full-text capture matching the exact proposed title, authors, publication category, selected-version locator or strong identifier, canonical version-resolution state, and component-scoped correction/retraction lineage. Human verification of all six proposal metadata fields, retraction or correction status, and every claim remains mandatory. A bounded recovery operation may finish only an already-admitted pre-upgrade V1 decision with unchanged V1 bytes after current matching-capture checks; it cannot create a new V1 decision or claim V2 assurance. This adds no upload, fetch, automatic scientific admission, campaign mutation, paid access, or claim-extraction authority. Historical v1 receipts remain readable with their original assurance only.
